We will find it convenient to define the _sequential composition_ of two transition graphs. Intuitively, the traces of the composition of _G_ 1 and _G_ 2 will be those that can be obtained by concatenating a trace of _G_ 1 with a trace of _G_ 2. To keep the definitions and notations simple, we will assume (when taking sequential compositions) _|V_ init _|_ = _|V_ term _|_ = 1; this is true of the examples we analyze. It is easy to generalize to the case when this does not hold. Under this assumption, the unique vertex in _V_ init will be denoted as _v_ init and the unique vertex in _V_ term will be denoted as _v_ term.
